decisions.reason: This underground mining loader line is very close to the firm's existing engineering, underground-application and service knowledge, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is well placed to learn from early market use and improve rather than withdraw it quickly.

These underground mining dump trucks also build directly on the firm's related capabilities in specialized underground transport equipment and after-sales support, making early commercialization problems more likely to be addressed through iterative development than by dropping the line.
